summary: 13 acceptance criteria + 3 design checks: 16 PASS, 0 CONCERNS, 0 FAIL. The three findings raised at 388832f are re-verified RESOLVED at this commit — QA-1 (a latched-off pool refused every write until a process restart) end-to-end on the same PID, QA-3 (a bad date reported as a length error) at the route and in the panel, and the outcome button now filing «other:». Two P2 findings stay open and neither blocks: QA-4 (AC-1 names a route that has never existed — documentation) and QA-5 (the panel has no date control, so the correct new bad_date path is unreachable from the UI — pre-existing, backlog).

cases.persona: عبدالعزيز, the one operator, on a call with مجمع الرعاية الطبية
cases.preconditions: Given contact 966500000850 has props {} — six «ناقص» holes — behind a real Postgres ledger
cases.steps: When he types «د. سارة العتيبي · مديرة العيادة» into صاحب القرار and saves (POST /admin/contact/props, source forced human)
cases.expected: Then 200 persisted:true, the value is stored with provenance, survives a re-GET and a psql read, and appends exactly one prop:decisionMaker line to the timeline (FR-1, FR-7, BR-5)
cases.actual: 200 {ok:true,persisted:true} with source:human, by:عبدالعزيز; the row is in Postgres; one timeline line names key + writer

cases.persona: عبدالعزيز, glancing at a record the assistant filled during a live conversation
cases.preconditions: Given the agent's record_schedule tool wrote الخطوة التالية as a reading (source:agent, by:agent:record_schedule) through the real handleInbound loop
cases.steps: When he taps «أكّد» — the real teal pill in the real page, one tap, no dialog (design-plan §3)
cases.expected: Then the row flips قراءة → حقيقة, the signature reads «أكّدها عبدالعزيز», and `prior` holds the agent's value/by/ts so the confirmation rate stays computable (FR-7, AC-4)
cases.actual: Row flipped to fact, signature «أكّدها عبدالعزيز», prior = {value, by:agent:record_schedule, ts}; timeline shows the agent write then the human confirm

cases.persona: the Arabic agent, mid-conversation, re-inferring over a value the operator typed
cases.preconditions: Given عبدالعزيز corrected الاهتمام by hand through the tags route (BR-2, one request, DB first)
cases.steps: When a customer message arrives and the model calls tag_interest with a different reading
cases.expected: Then the write is REFUSED (BR-1/BR-7): value/source/by/ts unchanged, the disagreement parked once as `contested`, one prop_rejected event logged, the tool result tells the model to stop retrying, interest_tags untouched, and nothing is sent
cases.actual: applied:false reason:human_value_wins; the human value is byte-identical afterwards; contested holds the agent reading once; one prop_rejected:productInterest event; zero calls to api.gupshup.io

cases.persona: عبدالعزيز, pasting a long note and clearing a field he filled by mistake
cases.preconditions: Given NFR-1 caps short text at 120 chars, note at 2000, disqualify free text at 200, and treats an empty human value as an explicit erase back to «ناقص»
cases.steps: When he saves 121 chars, then exactly 120, then an empty value, then a whitespace-only value
cases.expected: Then 400 {error:too_long} with NO write · 200 at the cap · the key is REMOVED rather than blanked, and the field renders «ناقص» again
cases.actual: 121 -> 400 too_long, ledger key ABSENT; 120 -> 200 stored length 120; empty -> key removed, row renders «ناقص»; whitespace treated as empty

cases.persona: anyone on the internet who found the hostname (assumption A-3: the admin token IS the authorization)
cases.preconditions: Given BR-1 says only a request carrying the admin token AND source:'human' may change a fact
cases.steps: When the write routes are called with no token, an empty token, a wrong token, and the token in the wrong place (query string / Authorization header instead of x-admin-token)
cases.expected: Then 401 every time, with no write reaching the ledger
cases.actual: 401 {status:unauthorized} on all five shapes; the ledger is unchanged after all of them

cases.persona: عبدالعزيز, typing what he just learned on a call while the ledger is not there
cases.preconditions: Given NFR-3: a silently lost fact reads «ناقص» after the next hydrate and destroys the trust this panel exists to earn
cases.steps: When (A) the engine boots with no DATABASE_URL, and (B) Postgres is killed mid-session with the editor open
cases.expected: Then (A) editors render disabled with the reason stated and the route 503s; (B) the save 503s persisted:false, the editor STAYS OPEN with «لم يُحفظ», nothing claims success, and the value is not half-written into memory
cases.actual: (A) propsWritable=false, pencils disabled with the reason; (B) 503 {persisted:false}, editor open with the draft preserved, in-memory props still {}, no success toast; the three retries after recovery return 200

cases.persona: عبدالعزيز, mid-call, typing a fact while the ledger fails over underneath him
cases.preconditions: Given finding QA-1 at 388832f: `db.connected` was a one-way latch, so after Postgres returned every write still 503'd until the PROCESS restarted, and the panel's «أعد المحاولة» could not succeed
cases.steps: When Postgres is stopped, a save is attempted, Postgres is started again, and the SAME process (PID asserted identical) retries the save
cases.expected: Then the retry SUCCEEDS without a restart and the fact is committed to Postgres (QA-1 resolved by db.reprobe() + propsWritable = db.enabled())
cases.actual: 503 while down; after recovery retry #1 and #2 return 200 persisted:true on the same PID; psql confirms both values committed; the log states «reconnected after a pool error»

cases.persona: عبدالعزيز, typing «اتصال بعد العيد» and mistyping the year in the date
cases.preconditions: Given finding QA-3 at 388832f: the date rule reused the `too_long` reason, so a 15-character phrase with a bad date told the operator his TEXT was too long
cases.steps: When a short valid phrase is saved with a date 3 years out, 2 years back, and unreadable; then with an in-range date; then a genuinely 121-char text; then the «غير مناسب» outcome button is pressed
cases.expected: Then the three bad dates return 400 {error:'bad_date'} (never a length error), the in-range date is accepted, 121 chars still returns too_long, and the outcome button files «other:» rather than «no_need:»
cases.actual: bad_date on all three; 200 on the control; too_long still returned for real over-length text; the panel owns a date-specific sentence; outcome button filed «other: غير مناسب (قرار بشري من اللوحة)»

cases.persona: عبدالعزيز opening a contact the campaign just delivered to, before any conversation
cases.preconditions: Given a contact created the way production creates one — a delivered status event over the webhook — with no properties at all
cases.steps: When he opens #customer/966500000880 at 1440 and at 390
cases.expected: Then six visible «ناقص» rows appear, each with its own sentence and a tappable CTA, and the invented contextScore and stage rail are gone (AC-13, discovery §3)
cases.actual: 6/6 rows marked «ناقص» at both viewports, every one tappable, header chip «ناقص ٥» (field 6 is shown but not counted, per design-plan §3), contextScore absent, stage rail absent, zero console errors

visual.capture_method: The app shell scrolls inside #body.ms-scroll, so a plain full_page screenshot is ONE screenful and the delivered panel sits below the fold. Every capture expands that container to its scrollHeight first, so all six comparisons cover the WHOLE record, not its first screen.

intended_change.prechange_build: e60c069 built in a git worktree and booted on :8190 against the SAME ledger
intended_change.summary: customer 1440: +18px height, 17.6% of the common region changed, bbox (31,29)-(1440,1656) — the panel replaces the 6-node stage rail and the 2x2 mcards grid. customer 375: +558px, 31.3%. customer 768: +592px, 20.0%. kmon 768: 10.0% — the 599px->939px breakpoint moves the tablet width onto the stacked row layout, which is the intended fix. kmon 1440: 0.19%, confined to the clock. These exceed the 1% drift threshold BY DESIGN: they are the feature. They are reported here rather than used as the gate's baseline, because a drift threshold cannot judge an intended addition.

design_conformance.result: 30 checks, 0 failed — design-plan §6.1/§6.2/§6.3, the §4 provenance tokens, the §5 deletions, WCAG AA contrast, visible focus, RTL
design_conformance.note: Four checks failed on the first pass and every one was MY measurement error, not a defect: the 7th .pm mark is field 4's deliberate second mark (§3); .pm-a is authored 1.5px dashed and Chromium reports the 1px used value at dpr 1; the «ناقص» rows carry their word as a full sentence in .fval-m; and §6.3's 40px rule names pencil/أكّد/صحّح, all of which measure 40px, while the 36px .add CTAs match DESIGN.md's own pill token.

observations: The three `.add` miss-state CTAs are 36px tall on mobile — the approved DESIGN.md pill token, above WCAG 2.5.8 AA (24px), below the 44px AAA guideline. Recorded, not raised as a finding.
The header title reads «جهات الاستهداف» on the customer record at both e60c069 and f54835c — pre-existing, unchanged by this delivery, out of scope, logged for the Planner.

limits: NO WhatsApp message was sent, to any number, at any point (CLAUDE.md §8, standing rule of Aug 12). Two independent walls held: GUPSHUP_* forced empty so outboundReady() is false and baseParams() throws, plus a fetch-layer spy that throws on api.gupshup.io. Evidence: regression/egress-assertion.txt.
The OpenAI transport is stubbed offline and deterministic; the agent's REAL tool-dispatch loop runs. No spend, no third-party call of any kind.

The working tree carries one uncommitted change at this commit — scripts/qa-crm.py gains an s1-wide-row assertion. It is a test script, not product code, and is not part of f54835c; every product measurement above is of the committed tree.

The gate's pixel baseline is a render-stability reference, not an approved-design render: there is no captured prototype image for this cycle. Design correctness is instead asserted numerically (30/30) in visual/design-conformance.txt, and the pre-change comparison is in regression/pixel-intent.txt. This is why visual scores 13/15 and not 15/15.
The harness runs against a local Postgres 16 in Docker, not Fly's managed instance; the failover behaviour in SC-7 is therefore proven against a real Postgres but not against a real Fly failover.
falsification: SC-7 would have FAILED if the retry after recovery returned 503, or if the engine PID had changed — both are asserted in the artifact.
SC-3 would have FAILED if the stored human value changed by one byte after the agent's re-inference.
AC-5 would have FAILED on any nulled key after the unrelated events and re-hydrate.
The pixel comparisons would have FAILED on any mismatch above 1%, and the diff is recomputed by the gate itself from the images on disk — the ratios in this file cannot be asserted into passing.
The residual on #kmon is located to a specific 96x36px box; had it been anywhere else, the claim «it is the clock» would have been falsified.
